feature_transform: raw frozen ResNet18 features plus bias; no normalization, projection, whitening or fitted adapter
initialization: independent uniform [-1/sqrt(512), 1/sqrt(512)] weights and bias, matching torch.nn.Linear(512,1); paired across rho
optimizer: ordinary full-batch parameter gradient descent; no weight decay or momentum
step_rule: 1/L with L=1.5*||X||op^2/n for mean negative per-query log evidence; image exposure is balanced
pairing: one disjoint homogeneous pair per image; degree-eight mixed bipartite graph, including two connected cycle matchings; fixed query support across rho
weighting: rho times mixed-query mean plus (1-rho) times homogeneous-query mean; equivalent to integer query repetitions for listed rational rho
reasoning: exact posterior independently within each query; a shared deterministic predictor ties repeated image occurrences; no extra cross-query equality factors in the posterior
supervised_control: ordinary gradient descent on individual labels from a zero head, same features and step; separate linear-realizability witness
train_diagnostic: weighted per-query loss, concept accuracy, count accuracy by type, gradient norm and final-window prediction persistence
test_diagnostic: all 2000 official bird/cat test images; 4000 fixed pairs balanced over ordered class combinations; count-type and rho-reweighted accuracies
